title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
sourceTitle: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
synopsis: An ice planet, a swamp, a city in the clouds, and a sentence at the end of a long fall that you will hear forever.

nodes.text: Wampa tracks in the snow, and the sun going down fast.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You commit to “Report and return.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Probe droid spotted. The Empire is on the way.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Evacuate first” back. Care shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Hold the line” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Soldier.

nodes.text: Walkers on the ridge, and only one trick left.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Clever—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Strafe the cockpits” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Direct.

nodes.text: Imperial troops in the corridor and a hyperdrive that coughs.

choices.consequence: “Stay and fix it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Bold.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Desperate.

nodes.text: Sensors lie. The swamp rises up to grab the landing skids.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Surrender—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Trust the panel.” The story records the instinct as “Stubborn” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Vader's mask in your visor, and your saber already drawn.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Drop the saber” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Reckless.

nodes.text: Yoda says size matters not. The marsh disagrees.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hope.
You commit to “Walk away.” The story records the instinct as “Doubt” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Never tell you the odds. The cockpit goes dark for a second.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
“Climb out” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cautious.

nodes.text: A cave that breathes. The stars at its mouth like teeth.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Quick—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Stealth.

nodes.text: A line of them on a Star Destroyer deck. One in green Mandalorian plate.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cunning.
“Run sublight” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.

nodes.text: Lando smiles too wide and the dinner doors slide open on Vader at the head of the table.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Draw.” The story records the instinct as “Quick” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: Han goes first, and Leia holds his face.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Stoic.

nodes.text: Lando whispers there is a way out for the others, if you trust him now.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mercy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wary—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Vader is patient and you are not. Sparks on a catwalk over nothing.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Press the attack” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Defend.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Boba Fett's prize lifted onto a transport while you bleed in a corridor.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Pursue Fett” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Pursue Vader” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Duty.

nodes.text: A hand cut. A truth offered. A long fall to nothing.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take his hand.” The story records the instinct as “Tempted” and carries it forward.
“Let go” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: True.

nodes.text: Lando at the controls, Leia at the cockpit, a voice in your mind saying her name.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Hope—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Stay still.” The story records the instinct as “Spent” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: It is fixed by a fussy gold droid pieced back together in a sack.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Faith—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Limp on sublight.” The story records the instinct as “Practical” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Medical frigate, new hand, old face in the window.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
There is no taking “Turn away” back. Hard shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He will find Han or he will die trying.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Hope.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Stubborn.

nodes.text: The galaxy is wider and worse than yesterday, and you are still in it.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take the next mission.” The story records the instinct as “Soldier” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Sit a moment.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You return to the swamp to finish what you started, and Yoda is shorter and stranger and entirely correct, again.
You and Lando burn a hundred contacts and a half a dozen ships looking for one slab of carbonite across a galaxy that does not want it found.
You learn to live with the new hand, and with the sentence, and you do not lie down. That is the lesson the Empire never expected anyone to learn.
